summary: Indian stocks have clawed back much of their sharp opening fall and are trading modestly lower, with pharma holding up while heavyweights such as M&M and HDFC Bank weigh.

detail.leaders: Pharma names such as Cipla and Dr Reddy's; ONGC, Max Healthcare and SBI in early trade
detail.laggards: M&M and HDFC Bank; Shriram Finance, IndiGo, Maruti in early trade
detail.tone: A live read of mid-morning trade. Firmer than the previous note: the market has recovered a good part of its gap-down open, and volatility has eased.
watch: Whether the recovery extends into positive territory
Foreign flows, which have supported the market all week
